The paragraph mentions "state-of-the-art quantum encryption techniques" as a future-proof method for securing communications. It notes that while these methods are largely experimental, they show promise in providing security that cannot be undermined by traditional or even quantum computing attacks. This suggests that, according to the text, quantum encryption is highly effective and robust, offering superior security compared to traditional methods, although it is not yet fully mature or widely deployed.
